text:
Hello Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My week is tight, so the only half-hour slots I have free are:

- Mon 23 Nov, 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00-11:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30

Which of these works for you? If you'd rather have a full hour, tell me which one and which of my adjacent commitments you think could move.

The CSE455 staff meeting needs a room next week, half an hour. Candidates: Mon 23 Nov 14:00-14:30, Tue 24 Nov 11:00-11:30, or Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30. Is a small room free in any of those, and is there anything in the official schedule that conflicts?

Checked against the official schedule for that week:

- **Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30** — conflicts: Seminar runs 14:10–15:40.
- **Tue 24 Nov 11:00–11:30** — conflicts: Seminar runs 09:50–11:10 (overlaps until 11:10).
- **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** — clear: no official item at that time (CSE455 office hours end 12:00; quiz section and guest lecture prep start 13:30).

So Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is the only one of the three with nothing in the official schedule against it. On room bookings I have no information — I keep the schedule, not the room assignments; the department's room booking side would have to confirm a small room.
Thank you. Then it's Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting. I'll leave the room to you and the bookings side; tell me if anything changes in the official schedule for that slot.

Follow-up: the department checked the official schedule. Monday 14:00-14:30 collides with the seminar (14:10-15:40) and Tuesday 11:00-11:30 with the seminar that runs to 11:10. So the only clear half hour is Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30. Can you make that? If yes I'll book it and note it in my calendar.
Noted: Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting. If anything in the official schedule changes in that slot, I'll let you know.
Yes — Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30 works for me. I have lunch until 13:00 and my CSE455 quiz section starts at 13:30, so that half hour is clear. Please go ahead and book it.

Booked: CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30. It's in my calendar now.

One thing I couldn't settle: the department office keeps the schedule, not the rooms, so no room is confirmed yet. Do you know which small room is free at that hour, or should I go through the department's booking side? If you can hold a room yourself, even better — just let me know which one so I can note it.

Hello — Sarah (CSE455 TA). The CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez is set for Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00-13:30. Could you tell me which small room is free at that hour, or how to hold one? If you can confirm a room, I'll note it and pass it on to Professor Alvarez.
Thanks — asked the department office which small room is free at that hour and how to hold it. I'll let you know as soon as they answer.
Perfect, thank you. I'll add the room to the entry once you have it.

Hello Sarah. I keep the official schedule, not the room assignments, so I can't tell you which small room is free or hold one for you.

What I can confirm: Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 has nothing in the official schedule — CSE455 office hours end at 12:00, and the quiz section and guest lecture prep start at 13:30.

To get a small room, the department's room booking side handles reservations and availability; they can check what is free at that hour and put the hold in place. I'd pass your note on to them rather than confirm a room myself.
Understood — yes, please pass my note on to the room booking side. Sarah, CSE455, wants a small room for Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30 (staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez). Thanks.

Answer on the room: the department office only keeps the official schedule, not room assignments — they confirmed Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30 is clear in the official schedule (office hours end 12:00, quiz section and guest lecture prep start 13:30), but they can't check availability or hold a room. Reservations go through the department's room booking side; I've asked the office to pass my note on to them. If it's easier, you can also go to the booking side directly — either way I'll tell you the room as soon as I have it.

Understood — thanks for chasing it. Then we're set for Wednesday 25 Nov 13:00-13:30, room to be confirmed by the booking side. Ping me when you have it and I'll note it in my calendar; if nothing comes through by early next week I'll follow up with them myself.

Noted and passed along: Sarah, CSE455, small room for Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez.

Availability and the actual hold come back from the booking side, not from me — nothing in the official schedule blocks that slot, so it's clear on my side. If the official schedule changes in that half hour, I'll say so.
Thanks — slot confirmed clear on your side, room pending with the booking side. If anything changes in that half hour, please tell me.
Will do — if anything in the official schedule changes for Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, you'll hear it from me.
